original.statement: The `ip-allocation-timeout` CLI flag has been removed; CIDR identity allocation is now always asynchronous.

decision.reason: The 1.16 upgrade notes, under "Removed Options", say "The `ip-allocation-timeout` flag ... has been removed" [ev-0b06499d6851]. That supports a cli-flag subject named --ip-allocation-timeout, with the leading -- the family convention requires and no component, because the text names none. It also supports the change type "removed". The neighbouring items in the same section are also flag removals, which fits this reading [ev-e477115a445b].
